fields.label: Platform Domain
fields.description: Schools' default addresses are <school>.<this domain>, e.g. stemicschools.com.

fields.label: DNS Lookup Service
fields.description: Used to check custom-domain ownership (DNS-over-HTTPS JSON). Default: Cloudflare.

fields.label: Create school sites on this server
fields.description: Turns queued sites into real ones on this bench. Builds them as the limited database account (stemic_provisioner) whose password is in the server's secrets file, /etc/stemic/secrets.env (README: Secrets).

fields.label: Local Site Suffix
fields.description: Sites created here are named <school>.<this>, e.g. localhost on a development machine.

fields.label: Apps on Each School Site
fields.description: One per line, in install order.

fields.label: Bench Path
fields.description: Leave blank to use this bench.

fields.label: Billing Name
fields.description: Shown as the seller on invoices and receipts.

fields.label: Months per Invoice
fields.description: The period a new subscription invoice covers unless you choose otherwise.

fields.label: Invoice Renewals This Many Days Early
fields.description: A renewal invoice is raised automatically this long before a subscription ends. 0 = never automatically.

fields.label: Payment Instructions
fields.description: Printed on invoices. {invoice} and {amount} are filled in, e.g. 'Pay via M-Pesa Paybill 123456, Account {invoice}'.

fields.label: Agents Earn Commission On
fields.description: Each agent's rate is on their agent record.

fields.label: Post to accounts
fields.description: Post each subscription invoice, payment and agent commission to ERPNext on this site, as Sales Invoices, Payment Entries and Journal Entries. Needs ERPNext installed here and Set Up Accounts run.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The ERPNext company that keeps Stemic's books, e.g. Stemic Schools Ltd.
